text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 2:3 (approximately 0.667:1), target canvas 1024 × 1536 pixels.

Vertical close chest-up romantic fantasy portrait of an exceptionally beautiful slim adult male merfolk prince with very pale porcelain skin, amber-gold almond eyes, elegant long narrow face, high soft cheekbones, straight fine nose, muted rose lips, delicate pointed ears, long flowing silver-lavender hair with loose waves and airy parted bangs, silver-blue dangling earring and a fine silver necklace with a small blue gemstone pendant. Head subtly tilted, tender direct gaze and softly parted lips. Hair frames both sides of the face and continues down chest. One bare shoulder, translucent pale-lavender silk across lower chest and jeweled shoulder drape on the opposite shoulder. Rich blurry cool-blue crystal palace, chandeliers and shining bokeh behind. Premium romantic otome 2.5D/3D fantasy illustration with softly sculpted dimensional features, luminous translucent porcelain skin, extremely detailed wispy hair strands, pearlescent silk, silver filigree, crystals and gemstones; pale icy blue, silver, lavender and champagne light, bright diffused bloom, polished rendering and soft depth of field. No cartoon outlines, coarse skin, gritty live-action texture, dark murky lighting or watermark.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt:
Create an exceptionally beautiful ORIGINAL adult male lead for an otome romance game, RIAN, a 23-year-old merman prince. Art direction: polished 2.5D / stylized 3D otome character modeling, unmistakably a high-end game cinematic render, NOT live-action or a photo. Use supplied reference 1 for the quality of stylized facial modeling and iridescent translucent ear fins; reference 2 for graceful long hair and marine-prince silhouette. These are art-direction references, not identities to copy. Create an original face.

Single vertical chest-up portrait, three-quarter head facing the viewer, relaxed confident intimate eye contact and a very slight teasing smile. Beautiful finely sculpted young adult masculine face, smooth taper from cheekbones to a precise but not excessively pointed chin, almond-shaped luminous blue-gray eyes with elongated softly shaded upper lids, elegant straight eyebrows, refined nose, softly defined rose lips. Balanced adult male neck and shoulders, lean graceful swimmer musculature, not massive, not childlike. Polished warm-ivory skin shader with soft subsurface scattering and gentle rose warmth around eyelids, no photographic pores, freckles, beard shadow or grunge. Face must be cleanly lit and readable, not blown out.

Long moon-silver hair with a very pale periwinkle gradient toward the ends, parted loosely around the forehead with finely separated sculpted strands, layered framing pieces near the jaw, the remaining hair flowing beyond the shoulders. Bilateral translucent fin ears, delicate three-rib fan shape, pale aqua grading to lilac edges, organically attached. Signature jewelry: one asymmetrical silver crescent shell clasp near his left shoulder, one short fine silver chain carrying a single small teardrop aquamarine at his sternum, a short pearl drop attached to the left clasp. Bare shoulders and upper chest with one flowing pearl-white translucent chiffon drape from his left shoulder; tasteful regal aquatic costume, shoulders frame the face rather than jewelry clutter. Tiny pearly scale accents ONLY at the outer collarbones. No heavy tunic, armor, huge crown, antlers, tattoos or sprawling body chains.

Background softly blurred luminous blue sea-palace arch; pearl white, blue-gray and pale lilac palette. Soft beauty key light, cool marine rim, exquisite hair rendering and fine nacre material. Strong 3D volume and elegant stylized features, no ink outlines, no flat cel shading, no wax doll, no hyperreal human face. Prioritize beauty, expression and visual clarity. No text, captions, watermark, collage, or bath scene. Output one original character portrait.
